senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.חָכָם , wise; sage, scholar.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 3:12">Targ. I Kings III, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 19:32">Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 32</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76b:2">Ab. Zar. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן ח׳ למיעבד וכ׳</he> who but R. … is wise enough to do that?; <cite ref="Pesachim 76a:2">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite>.—
Tam. 32ᵃ אידן מתקרי ח׳ who is to be called a wise man?; a. fr.—Esp. Ḥakham, a scholar’s title, inferior to Rabbi.
B. Mets. 86ᵃ top ח׳ יתקרי וכ׳ shall be called a Ḥakham, but not a Rabbi.
Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ דמנייתך ח׳ that I have appointed thee a Ḥ. (intimating that he would never be a Rabbi); a. e.—Pl. חַכִּימִין, חַכִּימַיָּא, הַכִּימֵי.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:30">Targ. Job XL, 30</cite> (h. text <he>חַבָּרִים</he>, cmp. <cite ref="H00109"><he>חָבֵר</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Niddah 20b:1">Nidd. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה ח׳ יהודאי</he> how wise the Jews are.
Sot. IX, 15 (49ᵃ) שרו ח׳ וכ׳ the Ḥăkhamimmim began to be (in scholarship) like common school teachers.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 20:16">Targ. II Sam. XX, 16</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="H00921"><he>חַכִּימָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 9:16">Targ. Jer. IX, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 5:29">Targ. Jud. V, 29</cite> <cite ref="H00918"><he>חַכִּימַת</he></cite> (constr. pl.).
